# v2026.11.2

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.11.2.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.11.2.md).

This release covers **2 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- Resolve invoice holds with source-amount comparisons and links to the saved rule that needs attention, while protecting unsaved edits and keeping unknown tax unknown. ([#472](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/472))
- Work across job-board lanes on one continuous neutral surface without changing their widths or navigation. ([#472](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/472))

## Fixes

- Compare source invoice amounts with reconstructed job lines, open the responsible rule, and see source Recheck progress, failures and cooldowns without losing unsaved edits. Jobs held without an invoice no longer misleadingly say Drafted, and non-change holds open the existing Jobs instructions instead of an unavailable comparison. Unknown source tax stays unknown rather than inheriting an approximate catalog match. ([#472](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/472))
- Keep board lanes on a continuous neutral surface while retaining fixed lane widths, navigation and the trailing workspace. ([#472](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/472))
